notesStmt.note: Given its publication date and the fact that one of the envelopes on which the poem is written draft bears postmarks for January 27 and January 28, Whitman probably wrote this manuscript during the last days of January or in February 1888.

"Soon Shall the Winter's Foil Be Here" was first published in the New York Herald on February 21, 1888. It was then reprinted in November Boughs (1888) and Leaves of Grass (1891–1892), where it appeared in the "Sands at Seventy" annex.
